title: Relocated worktree: Cargo integration-test binaries keep stale absolute CARGO_BIN_EXE paths
outcome:
Gate failure evidence (2026-09-26): full gate test-f299baaa-c051-4dbe-bdcc-403968a0b635 in worktree .tmp/wt-waits, rust-tests stage. tests/review_freeze_cli.rs:82 Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_termal")) panicked with Os error 3 NotFound.

Diagnosis (confirmed): the worktree had been moved with git worktree move from C:\github\Personal\TermAl-wt-waits to C:\github\Personal\TermAl\.tmp\wt-waits, so delegated reviewers could use it as cwd, since they must stay inside the project. Cargo did not rebuild the integration-test binary because its inputs were unchanged: review_freeze_cli-7be1bc77602b0870.exe was built at 08:20, before the move. It still embeds C:\github\Personal\TermAl-wt-waits\target\debug\termal.exe, which no longer exists, while termal.exe was rebuilt at the new path at 09:26. The pre-move gate test-7c5416e9 passed.

Classification: environment (a stale build artifact after relocation), not a product or test defect.
Fix applied: cargo clean -p termal in the moved worktree, then a fresh full gate on the unchanged input.
Follow-up option: after a worktree move, or when target/ was produced at another path, the launcher could detect it (for example CARGO_BIN_EXE paths outside the current root), or docs/test.md could say to run cargo clean -p termal after git worktree move. Better still, create review worktrees under .tmp/ from the start.
